searchText: When is the EIP for BLS threshold signatures planned? Soon™ or never. Unclear which. 😖 I'm closer to you than you may think, just not an absolutist. Anyway, all of the dead links here are due to a change in where the minutes for AllCoreDevs meetings are kept. I'm not sure whether to fix the links, replace them with just the meeting numbers without direct links, or ask for a rewrite that doesn't require a recitation of all of the meetings this EIP was discussed in.. The problem is just that > All%20Core%20Devs%20Meetings got changed to > AllCoreDevs-Meetings I was going to just fix it for now, but I still don't have write access. So here is a PR instead. https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/4639
